title: Marketing & Membership Manager
description:
We are very pleased to be working alongside our reputable, friendly and highly established client as they seek to recruit a Marketing and Membership Manager into their team within their offices based close to Haywards Heath

Marketing and Membership Manager - office based role but with flexible working

Haywards Heath outskirts with free parking available for all staff on site. Due to workplace location it is essential to be a driver and have your own transport. Rural and beautiful office / workplace.

Full time permanent role - Monday - Friday (Apply online only)

Salary 37000- 38000 plus good pension scheme and 28 days annual leave (including bank holidays), Life assurance. An additional 3 days or annual leave are given due to Christmas shutdown

We are seeking an experienced and creative Marketing & Membership Manager to lead the marketing strategy for a well-established organisation. This is a varied and influential role responsible for driving admissions, membership growth, venue enquiries, educational programme engagement, and overall brand awareness. Working as part of the Senior Leadership Team (with one direct report), you will develop and deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns, manage agency relationships, oversee membership activity, and support the long-term growth of the organisation.

The role - Marketing and Membership Manager

This opportunity would suit a proactive marketing professional with experience in event marketing, digital campaigns and stakeholder management

We are looking for a confident and commercially minded marketing professional who can successfully manage multiple projects while maintaining high standards and attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities include:

Marketing Strategy & Campaign Management
- Develop and implement the annual marketing strategy to support organisational objectives.
- Create and manage integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, social media, email, PR and advertising channels.
- Manage marketing plans that increase awareness of initiatives, educational programmes and venue hire services.
- Monitor campaign effectiveness and deliver data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement.

Digital Marketing & Content
- Oversee website content, updates and ongoing development.
- Lead social media strategy, content planning and audience growth across multiple platforms.
- Manage email marketing campaigns and customer databases.
- Create compelling marketing content including website copy, newsletters, advertising and promotional materials.
- Utilise AI and emerging marketing technologies to improve efficiency, engagement and campaign performance.

Brand & Communications
- Act as a brand ambassador, ensuring consistent messaging across all channels.
- Coordinate production of marketing collateral including brochures, leaflets, event guides, signage and digital assets.
- Develop strong relationships with media partners and oversee PR activity.

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
- Manage and develop the Membership & Marketing Administrator - reports direct to this position.
- Lead external marketing and PR agencies, ensuring effective delivery and value for money.
- Build strong relationships with suppliers and stakeholders.
- Contribute to Senior Leadership Team discussions and strategic decision-making.

Experience, knowledge and competencies required:
- Proven experience in a Marketing Manager or similar senior marketing role.
- Experience developing and delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Strong digital marketing knowledge including social media, email marketing and website management.
- Excellent copywriting, communication and content creation skills.
- Experience managing external agencies, suppliers and stakeholders.
- Ability to analyse performance data and identify trends and opportunities.

For more information regarding this new and exciting Marketing and Membership Manager opportunity, please apply now! Short-listing will take place soon - don't miss out!

Berry Recruitment Services Ltd T/A First Recruitment Services is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

Please note that no terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate on the grounds of a person's gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability or sexual orientation. Every candidate will be assessed only in accordance with their merits, qualifications and ability to perform the duties of the job

title: Marketing - Community Coordinator
description:
ASL Technical is a specialist recruitment and solutions provider supporting the engineering and technology sectors. We work closely with innovative organisations and talented professionals, helping to build high-performing teams across the UK and beyond. Our client is an established marketing business specialising in the high-technology electronics sector. They work with innovative organisations across electronics, semiconductor, embedded systems, and advanced engineering, helping them build engaged audiences and drive growth through targeted digital marketing. Due to continued expansion, they are now looking for a Digital Marketing Community Coordinator to join their team. The Role This is a dynamic and hands-on position, ideal for someone who enjoys combining creativity with data-driven marketing. You will play a key role in managing digital campaigns, creating engaging content, and growing a highly technical engineering audience. Our client is looking for bold, brave individuals, not afraid to go the extra mile to get the job done. Key Responsibilities
- Support the growth and engagement of a community of electronics engineers
- Manage day-to-day community interactions, including responding to comments, messages, and discussions
- Assist with planning and executing digital marketing campaigns across email and social channels
- Create and schedule content across LinkedIn, YouTube, and email newsletters
- Maintain and manage weekly content calendars aligned to campaigns and events
- Track and report on campaign performance (engagement, reach, clicks, and website traffic)
- Produce regular performance reports with clear insights and recommendations
- Support webinar promotion and audience growth initiatives
- Assist with SEO optimisation across website content and campaigns
- Maintain data quality and segmentation across email and CRM platforms
- Generate new ideas to grow and engage the audience

Skills & Experience Required
- Experience in social media marketing, particularly LinkedIn and YouTube
- Strong written communication and copywriting skills, with the ability to write for a technical audience
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and drive improvements
- Highly organised and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines
- Basic understanding of SEO principles (desirable)
- Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and reporting tools

Desirable Tools & Platforms
- HubSpot (CRM, email marketing, workflows)
- Mailchimp or similar email platforms
- Google Analytics
- YouTube Studio analytics
- LinkedIn campaign and page management tools

What They re Looking For
- Data-driven and goal-oriented
- Creative, with an eye for engaging content
- Proactive and takes ownership of tasks
- Curious and eager to learn about new technologies and engineering topics
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

Nice to Have (Not Essential)
- Interest in electronics, embedded systems, or engineering
- Experience with webinars, events, or video content
- Understanding of B2 B marketing or lead generation

Why Apply?
- Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology clients
- Play a key role in growing a specialist engineering audience
- Join a collaborative and fast-growing marketing business
- Real scope to develop your digital marketing career

This vacancy is being advertised by ASL Technical. To apply, please submit your CV or get in touch for more information.

title: Marketing Assistant (Part-Time) ASAP Start
description:
Marketing Assistant (Part-Time)

2 Days Per Week

14 - 18 per Hour (DOE)

Are you looking for a varied part-time marketing role where you can develop your skills across social media, content creation, and digital marketing?

We are seeking a Marketing Assistant to support marketing activity across a range of established brands and services. This is a hands-on role suited to someone with previous marketing experience who enjoys creating content, managing social media platforms, and supporting marketing campaigns.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build on their existing marketing skills within a supportive and flexible environment.

The Role

Working as part of a busy team, you'll provide day-to-day marketing support and help ensure marketing activity remains consistent and engaging across multiple channels.

Key responsibilities include:
- Assisting with the management of LinkedIn, Instagram and email marketing campaigns
- Creating and scheduling content for social media platforms
- Updating website content and uploading marketing materials
- Drafting newsletters, marketing emails and promotional communications
- Supporting SEO activity and basic website optimisation
- Monitoring social media engagement and responding to enquiries where appropriate
- Assisting with campaign planning and marketing projects
- Maintaining content calendars and marketing schedules
- Tracking campaign results and preparing simple performance reports
- Conducting competitor and market research
- Providing general administrative support to the marketing function
- Contributing ideas for new content and promotional activity

About You

We're looking for someone who:
- Has some previous experience in a marketing, communications, digital marketing or social media role
- Is confident using social media platforms in a professional setting
- Has strong written communication skills and enjoys creating content
- Has good attention to detail and organisational skills
- Is comfortable working with Microsoft Office and online marketing tools
- Understands the basics of email marketing and digital communications
- Can manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
- Works well independently and as part of a team
- Is enthusiastic, proactive and keen to learn

What's in it for You?
- Flexible part-time hours
- Opportunity to broaden your marketing experience
- Varied role across social media, content and digital marketing
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Chance to contribute ideas and develop new skills

Who Would This Suit?

This role would be ideal for a Marketing Assistant, Marketing Administrator, Digital Marketing Assistant, Social Media Assistant, or someone with some marketing experience looking for a flexible part-time opportunity.

If you're looking for a hands-on marketing role where you can develop your skills and make a valuable contribution, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Executive - Part Time
description:
Marketing Executive (Part-Time)

2 Days Per Week Ideally Tuesday and Thursday but flexible

18- 24 an hour

Are you a proactive marketer who enjoys creating clear, effective communications and helping organisations grow through thoughtful, professional marketing?

We are seeking a Part-Time Marketing Executive to take ownership of marketing activity across a range of established brands and services. This is a hands-on role offering the opportunity to shape messaging, increase engagement and support future growth.

You'll be someone who can quickly understand an audience, create compelling content and ensure marketing activity is delivered consistently across multiple channels.

The Role

Working closely with the leadership team, you'll review existing marketing activity and help drive a more focused and effective communications strategy.

Key responsibilities include:
- Managing and developing LinkedIn, Instagram and email marketing campaigns
- Creating engaging content for websites, newsletters and social media
- Supporting SEO activity and website optimisation
- Reviewing and refining marketing messages to ensure consistency and impact
- Planning and delivering campaigns to increase engagement and brand awareness
- Managing communication schedules and recommending the right frequency of activity
- Supporting internal and external marketing initiatives
- Tracking campaign performance and identifying opportunities for improvement
- Bringing fresh ideas and taking ownership of projects from concept through to delivery

About You

We're looking for someone who:
- Has previous experience within a marketing role
- Is confident creating content across digital platforms
- Has experience with LinkedIn marketing, email campaigns and website management
- Understands SEO and content optimisation
- Can produce professional, polished and engaging written communications
- Works well independently and uses their own initiative
- Is organised, proactive and commercially aware
- Enjoys building relationships and understanding customer needs
- Can balance creativity with professionalism

What We're Looking For

This role would suit someone who enjoys working within an established organisation where credibility, reputation and quality of communication are key.

We're looking for an individual who can help refine messaging, ensure communications are aligned and support the organisation's ambitions for growth through well-planned and effective marketing activity.

If you're looking for a varied marketing role where your ideas, initiative and expertise can make a genuine impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Manager
company: Lloyd Recruitment - East Grinstead - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Manager

Up to 38,000 DOE + benefits

Haywards Heath

Are you a natural communicator with a passion for marketing, a creative eye and the ability to turn great ideas into successful campaigns?

We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Marketing Manager to take the lead on marketing across our busy and varied organisation.

From promoting events to growing membership, and attracting new business to our events, no two days will be the same.

You will have the opportunity to shape how we promote what we do, reach new audiences and bring our activities to life through creative and effective marketing.

Working alongside a small, dedicated team, as well as external agencies and suppliers, you will lead on everything from advertising, PR and social media to website content, campaigns and brand development.

We are looking for someone who can think strategically but isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and get things done. Someone with fresh ideas, excellent communication skills and the confidence to build relationships, manage projects and make things happen.

You will ideally have:
- Experience in a marketing management role, with a track record of delivering successful campaigns
- A good understanding of digital marketing, social media and online advertising
- Excellent writing skills and an eye for creative content and design
- The ability to manage budgets, agencies and multiple projects
- A good understanding of what makes audiences engage and what drives commercial results
- A positive, flexible and hands-on approach
- The confidence to work with a wide range of people and stakeholders
- A marketing degree or CIM qualification would be an advantage, as would experience of WordPress and event marketing

Most importantly, we are looking for someone with ideas, enthusiasm and the drive to make a difference.

Extra info:
- Refer a friend and earn up to 500 (see website for details)
- Due to high application volumes, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you don't hear back within 5 days, please assume you have not been successful
- By applying, you accept Lloyd Recruitment Services' Privacy and GDPR Policy (see website)

Lloyd Recruitment Services are acting as an employment agency for this vacancy and are an equal opportunities employer.

title: Regional marketing Manager
description:
Regional Marketing Manager

Home based - with visits to hospitality sites across the South of England and surrounding areas

We're recruiting for a growing hospitality company looking for a Regional Marketing Manager to deliver effective local marketing across a portfolio of locations in the South of England. This is a broad, hands-on opportunity for a marketing generalist who enjoys variety, building relationships and turning commercial priorities into practical campaigns.

You'll work closely with local teams and central marketing specialists, combining the autonomy of remote working with plenty of face-to-face collaboration.

Key responsibilities
- Develop and deliver local marketing plans that reflect each site's individual proposition while supporting wider business objectives.
- Become the main marketing contact for your sites, building strong relationships with local leadership and operational teams.
- Coordinate integrated campaigns, briefing specialist teams across digital, email and paid media.
- Visit sites regularly to understand their audiences, local markets and commercial opportunities.
- Support quarterly planning, review campaign copy and help teams prioritise competing marketing needs.
- Contribute to the marketing integration of new sites as the company grows.

What's we're looking for
- Proven experience in a broad marketing role, with a track record of supporting multiple sites or branches
- Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to balance the needs of different teams and locations
- Experience developing integrated marketing plans, with a good understanding of digital, email and paid channels
- Excellent copywriting, proof-reading and communication skills, supported by sound commercial judgement.
- A proactive, organised and adaptable approach, with the ability to work independently and respond to changing priorities.
- Willingness to travel regularly and spend time on-site building relationships.

Experience in hospitality, property, retail, leisure or another multi-site consumer business would be ideal

Due to the 'field-based' nature of the role, you will need to hold a full UK driving licence

What's in it for you
- Exposure to growth and integration projects, with opportunities to broaden your responsibilities as the business develops.
- A supportive, collaborative team with regular contact and in-person meet-ups.
- Predominantly remote working, with autonomy to manage your workload and site relationships.

If you're a hands-on Marketer in the hospitality space who enjoys connecting with people and making things happen locally, apply today

title: SEO Manager
description:
SEO Manager role

Stratospherec is proud to be recruiting for one of the UK's Top Digital Marketing Agencies, with amazing offices in the heart of the Countryside around Burgess Hill area of West Sussex.

They are looking to recruit an experienced SEO Manager who has a background in working for Marketing Agencies helping clients with their SEO strategies and online digital presence.

Working alongside their Technical Director and SEO team, you will be responsible for conducting in-depth technical website audits, examining everything from site structure and page optimisation to link profiles and much more.

You will control ongoing and new SEO strategies for our varied mix of SEO clients with valuable thinking time to fully immerse yourself in our clients sites and user journeys.

Key responsibilities:
- Conducting extensive SEO site audits, delivering meaningful insights, and explaining findings and strategies to clients.
- Formulating, implementing and managing ethical SEO campaigns across our client portfolio.
- Providing medium to long-term strategic SEO direction.
- Providing detailed monthly SEO campaign task planning and management.
- Monitoring and analysing site performance, ensuring the clients web traffic is delivered.
- Create SEO and CRO campaigns that drive enquiries/sales of high quality and exceed performance targets

Employee Benefits:
- 28 days annual leave and additional time off between Christmas and New Year
- Paid day off on your birthday
- Pension scheme
- Private Healthcare including GP Access 24/7
- Hybrid working as standard and flexible working options to suit work/life balance
- Office lunches & Christmas parties and evening events
- Annual budget for individual training/development
- Celebration of achievements
- Death in service benefit
- Employee Assistance Programme

If this might be of interest, please send your CV for immediate interview?

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Social Media Coordinator

Location: Brighton

Salary: £31,720 - £39,520 per annum

At BIMM University, we're more than just an educational institution; we're a vibrant community dedicated to nurturing creativity and empowering students to reach their full potential. With campuses across the UK, Ireland, and Germany, we offer a diverse range of courses in modern music, performing arts, filmmaking and creative technology. Our commitment to excellence in creative arts education sets us apart, providing students with the knowledge, skills, and opportunities they need to succeed in their chosen fields.

About the Role

As Social Media Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating social media activity across BIMM University, with a particular focus on supporting student recruitment and engagement. Through engaging, audience-focused content, you'll help prospective students learn more about our courses, campuses and community.

Working closely with colleagues across the University, you'll identify content opportunities, support recruitment campaigns and use performance insights to help shape future activity.

What You'll Do:
- Coordinate and deliver engaging social media content across a range of platforms.
- Support the delivery of student recruitment campaigns and wider University communications activity.
- Collaborate with colleagues across the University to identify stories, content opportunities and key messages.
- Support campus-based Recruitment and Promotions Officers to capture and share content that reflects student life across our campuses.
- Monitor channel performance and campaign effectiveness, providing insight and recommendations to improve outcomes.
- Support paid social campaigns, content planning and reactive communications activity.
- Produce regular reports and management information for stakeholders.

What You'll Bring:
- Experience managing social media channels in a professional environment.
- Strong knowledge of social media management, scheduling and reporting tools.
- The ability to create engaging content tailored to different audiences and platforms.
- An analytical approach, with the ability to use performance data to inform decision-making.
- Experience using Adobe Creative Suite or similar creative software.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication skills and confidence working with a wide range of stakeholders.

We encourage early applications, as we may close the advert ahead of the stated deadline if we receive a high volume of interest.

Why BIMM University

We are a values-led organisation, meaning our core values underpin all that we do:

Believe in Everyone, Challenge the Norm, Grow Together, Do The Right Thing, Own It.

In addition to joining a committed and dedicated team, you will have access to:
- 25 days holiday per year (FTE)
- SMART pension
- A comprehensive benefits package

We continually strive to create a culture of inclusivity so that we truly represent our diverse communities. We particularly welcome applications from people of colour who are underrepresented in our organisation.

We are committed to promoting the safety and welfare of our students therefore, all successful applicants are required to complete a basic DBS disclosure. Depending on the role, you may be required to complete an enhanced check / enhanced check with barred list if required by statute and internal policy.

How To Apply

Click "Apply" and you will be redirected to our careers site to complete your application.
